newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Direct Capital invests NZ$12 mln in Airwork NZ.
newsitem.headline: Direct Capital invests NZ$12 mln in Airwork NZ.

text.p: Direct Capital Partners Partners Ltd has bought a 44.5 percent stake in airfreight and aviation company Airwork (NZ) for NZ$12 million, the New Zealand Stock Exchange said on Tuesday.
The NZSE said Airwork Managing Director Hugh Jones retained 55.5 percent ownership of the company.
Airwork would use the new capital to target further growth opportunities in airfreight and aircraft maintenance, and to retire existing debt.
Direct Capital specialises in investing in unlisted companies. -- Wellington newsroom 64 4 4734 746
